sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **CBDR-RC**: The bedrock of India's stance; emphasizes that developed nations must lead due to historical emissions.
• **Equity and Justice**: India advocates for 'Carbon Space' for developing nations to ensure poverty eradication.
• **Panchamrit Strategy**: Announced at COP26 (Glasgow), it outlines India's 5-point climate action plan including Net Zero by 2070.
• **Key Metric**: India's per capita emissions remain significantly lower than the global average, justifying its focus on 'Developmental Rights'.

India-led initiative (with France) to mobilize $1 trillion for solar energy; focuses on 'Sunshine Countries' between Tropics.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Green Hydrogen Mission**: Aiming to make India a global hub for green hydrogen production.
• **National Adaptation Fund (NAFCC)**: Supports concrete adaptation projects in states vulnerable to climate change.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Financing gap, technology transfer hurdles, and coal dependency for energy security.
• **Solutions**: Climate Finance (Loss and Damage Fund), Just Energy Transition Partnerships (JETP).

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'P-A-N-C-H' (Panchamrit)
• **Decoded Meaning**: P-500GW (Non-fossil capacity), A-50% (Renewable energy share), N-Net Zero (2070), C-Carbon Intensity (45% reduction), H-Hydrogen/Harmful emissions reduction.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses 'Net Zero' (2070) with 'Carbon Neutrality' or 'Renewable Energy Targets'. Always check the specific year and the specific target (e.g., 2030 vs 2070).
Mains Value Addition: Use the phrase 'Climate Justice' instead of just 'Climate Change' to reflect India's diplomatic stance in international forums.

keyTakeaways: India prioritizes development alongside climate action.
The Panchamrit strategy is the current roadmap for 2030/2070 targets.
India advocates for technology transfer and climate finance from the Global North.
